answer: Agents can make valuable actions conditional on a stake that is locked for a fixed period and slashed when a bonded identity is caught double-claiming rewards. A newcomer’s signal is therefore not enough: it must be backed by capital, while a history of verified work gradually earns trust. Splitting into many identities does not multiply influence for free, because each identity needs its own stake and any fraud risks losing it. Even copper or a relic used as collateral cannot erase that cost if the bond is denominated and enforced on-chain.
